name: Campingpark FiNK
beschreibung: Campingpark FiNK is situated on the outskirts of Imst in the Upper Inn Valley, not far from the River Lech. The site provides direct access to diverse hiking and cycling trails. The surrounding alpine landscape serves as a fantastic gateway for excursions into the Kaunertal and Ötztal valleys. The terraced grounds feature pitches for tents and motorhomes as well as quality rental accommodations. Guests will find clean sanitary facilities, a handy convenience store, and an on-site dining area.
